title: Silas and the Drop
author: Wren Pemberton
blurb: Felix Oyelaran, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
